profile.headline: Technical Troubleshooting, Information Quality & Team Leadership
profile.summary: My background spans software development, technical support, production mixing, retail team leadership and adult education. Across those roles, I’ve troubleshot problems, followed detailed procedures, checked information and product consistency, built internal tools, trained staff and helped teams get their work done.  I bring both technical experience and practical operational responsibility, from working with software and reference materials to preparing production batches, coordinating shifts and supporting students and coworkers. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science with an emphasis in Software and Mobile Applications Development, graduating Magna Cum Laude.  I’m open to full-time, part-time and temporary opportunities where I can put that range of experience to use, contribute to a team and continue learning. I’m available to start immediately and am flexible across shifts.

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description: Supervised cashier and customer-service work. Balanced tills, consolidated nightly deposits, and handled closing and lockup.

positions.title: Crew Member
positions.description: Handled drive-through orders and payments and coordinated orders with the kitchen.

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description: Managed shifts, trained staff, and handled cash reconciliation, inventory and ordering.

positions.title: Pre-Weigh Tech
positions.description: Through YES. Weighed and prepared ingredients for cosmetic production; followed specific ingredient, heating, cooling, mixing-speed and timing procedures. Drew samples from the top, middle and bottom of batches and checked thickness and consistency against specifications. Packed samples for QA review.

positions.title: Technical Customer Support, SimpliSafe account
positions.description: Troubleshot security systems, arranged replacement equipment, and helped with billing and account issues.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer III
positions.description:
At 3M Health Information Systems, my work included:
• Supporting the conversion of books, PDFs and other reference materials into linked web content used alongside medical billing and coding software.
• Developing an internal tool to compare website text against PDFs word for word.
• Developing a nightly crawler to check product links and their destinations.
• Using C#, JavaScript and HTML in reference and internal-tools work.

positions.title: Student Success Advisor(Programming Tutor)
positions.description: Worked with the dean to help struggling college students receive extra assistance, including tutoring and student check-ins. Planned school events, including a drone obstacle course, and filled in to teach a class.
